definition: This continuation makes twelve executable controller scenarios explicit from the existing routes and panels. It does not assert these names were a previously enumerated canonical acceptance list.
controllerScope: Actual BuriViewModel with platform, repository and gateway doubles; not Compose or provider end-to-end execution.

journeys.title: Sign-in and sign-out
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Actual sign-in provider, hardware and soft-keyboard submission, rotation during login, logout then another operator.

journeys.title: Home and unallocated shortcut
journeys.controllerCoverage: Repository values; unallocated filter applied before read
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Compare canonical balances, empty/error/loading/offline states and screen-reader order.

journeys.title: Payment search, filters, pagination and Back
journeys.controllerCoverage: Second page; query/filter/list position restored in memory
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Exercise two or more real pages, long names, Back/rotation/process death and keyboard dismissal.

journeys.title: Payment history and original receipt
journeys.controllerCoverage: Transaction-scoped history pagination; unchanged raw receipt; no mutation
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Verify original SMS, identifiers, timestamps, history ordering, clipboard selection and role restrictions.

journeys.title: Allocation and unresolved actions
journeys.controllerCoverage: Selection required; unresolved action blocks duplicate dispatch; explicit command clears selection
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Use genuine identities and PostgreSQL/provider reconciliation. Drop network after submit and verify one canonical posting.

journeys.title: Member enrollment and unsaved changes
journeys.controllerCoverage: Keep editing/discard; invalid name blocked; explicit enrollment clears draft
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Validate provider identity rules, duplicate membership, dirty-panel Back/swipe/Escape, IME and accessible errors.

journeys.title: Member ledger, export and lifecycle
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Reconcile actual ledger signs/balances and exported statement, file picker cancellation, access revocation and lifecycle policy.

journeys.title: Profile, passcode and reauthentication
journeys.controllerCoverage: Nested panel Back; passcode command clears session and panels
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test real PIN rotation, wrong current PIN, process death with credentials present and foreground reauthentication.

journeys.title: Staff account and removal confirmation
journeys.controllerCoverage: Contextual removal confirmation; cancel preserves edit; save returns to list
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test real authority boundaries, staff revocation, last-admin safeguards and TalkBack focus return.

journeys.title: Receiving-phone diagnostics and capture controls
journeys.controllerCoverage: Upload hold distinguished from member credit; pause/resume preserves queue
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Pair an authorized receiving phone, change SIM, replace phone, deny permissions, check queue retention and real carrier receipts. Staff APK must have no SMS access.

journeys.title: SMS filter, original evidence and access revocation
journeys.controllerCoverage: Queue filter; original source reachable; revocation removes SMS/raw state
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test real queue statuses, malformed/duplicate receipts, raw evidence readability, and server-authorized revocation.

journeys.title: Background, offline recovery and no replay
journeys.controllerCoverage: Foreground guard; blocked navigation until validation; recovery does not replay commands
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Real process kill/restart, offline cache expiry, return from settings, keystore restore failure and unknown financial outcomes.
